activity_summary: At the Sadlers' bakehouse Judith Sadler told you to sit. You offered to make Anne's purchase and found you knew less than she did. Hamnet Sadler told Anne the loaf was light, and said he was not teaching you. She let you finish once you had listened. A penny each for the twins. Susanna's went into a paper. She was not there.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Offered to buy, listened, and finished only after Anne let him.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Knew the loaf and the answer, and allowed the finish once he had heard it.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Named a penny, and kept Sadler's fact pointed at Anne.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted two pennies and Susanna's paper, and did not open the paper.

entities.name: Hamnet Sadler
entities.context: Told Anne the loaf was light, and refused to teach William.

entities.name: Judith Sadler
entities.context: Sat him down, and kept the purchase from turning into a gift.

quotes.speaker: judith_sadler
quotes.text: Sit, Will. You stand in my bakehouse like a man waiting to be paid for it.

quotes.speaker: hamnet_sadler
quotes.text: I am telling Anne. I am not teaching you, Will.

quotes.speaker: judith_shakespeare
quotes.text: Susanna is not here. Hers can travel in paper.
